Rationale.CS1_Results_vs_Conclusion: All evaluable conclusions in the plan.md match the results recorded in the implementation. The probe performance data (0.81-0.85 at optimal layers 27-35) matches the plan's claim of '0.81 ± 0.02 accuracy'. Filter head [35,19] is correctly identified with the highest AIE score (3.55). The logit lens baseline comparison is consistent with the recorded data showing logit lens reaches ~0.67 max while the probe achieves higher accuracy.
